title: An obstruction theory with countable compatibility gives openness of versality
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Verifies condition (4) of the SGE criterion: for the square-zero system R_n, builds tilde R = {(r_n)} with kernel M = prod M_n, embeds R -> tilde R -> A[M] in a short exact sequence of deformation situations whose kernel sequence computes lim M_n; the obstruction o_x(tilde R) vanishes by injectivity of O_x(prod M_n) -> prod O_x(M_n) since all xi_n lift; the tangent corrections t_n lift to t in T_x(M) by the product formula, and after replacing tilde xi by t · tilde xi the restriction to A[M] is trivial on each A[M_n], hence trivial on A[M] by (5)(a), and (RS*) pulls tilde xi back to a deformation over R.
